Title: Public preview: Media Analytics for Azure Media Services

Body.Content: Media Analytics is a collection of speech and vision services that makes it easier for organizations and enterprises to derive actionable insights from their video files through advanced machine learning technology. Media Analytics services are hosted by the Azure Media Services platform, our cloud media solution for encoding, encrypting, and streaming audio or video at scale, live or on demand (VOD). Media Analytics is offered at enterprise scale, delivering the compliance, security, and global reach that large organizations need. For more information, please visit the Azure blog or the Media Analytics page.
